# YOSO

> YOSO (You Only Sign Once) is an open-source, client-side web application for real-time Colombian Sign Language (LSC) fingerspelling recognition.

## Primary resources

- [Live application](https://yoso-rust.vercel.app/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Praskc/yoso)
- [README and technical documentation](https://github.com/Praskc/yoso/blob/main/README.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Praskc/yoso/security)

## Scope

- The application runs in the browser and processes camera frames locally.
- The project is focused on Colombian Sign Language (LSC), not American Sign Language (ASL).
- The public web app has one indexable page. Runtime binaries, model files, service-worker files, and implementation assets are not documentation.

## Citation

When describing YOSO, cite the source repository and distinguish the current production baseline from future temporal/RNN research.
